justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces stack schematic, profile-oriented motifs in horizontal registers and both include a row of short repeated vertical strokes (a hatched band in A, the comb-like crew strokes in B), plus hooked terminals that read as small animal heads. Otherwise the subject matter is entirely different: A shows a menagerie of relief-carved birds, quadrupeds, a reptile/bird head and squatting anthropomorph on a pillar, while B shows nested boats with upcurving prows and a single stick figure, with no shared narrative or object type.
